brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted raids across several villages in Ramallah district, according to Shehab Wire. The operation marked the latest in a series of military incursions into Palestinian-controlled areas of the West Bank.

The scope of the raids and their specific objectives remained unclear. Israeli forces have intensified operations in the Ramallah area in recent weeks, frequently entering Palestinian communities under the stated rationale of counterterrorism operations and security sweeps.
